# Aquaverse Park Guide
> Comprehensive visitor guide for Columbia Pictures Aquaverse — the world's first Columbia Pictures-themed water and theme park in Pattaya, Thailand.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://aquaverse-park.com/): Quick-reference guide with prices, hours, and park overview
- [Attractions](https://aquaverse-park.com/attractions.html): All rides, zones, and attractions with details
- [Tickets](https://aquaverse-park.com/tickets.html): Current pricing, packages, and booking guide
- [Getting There](https://aquaverse-park.com/getting-there.html): Transport options from Bangkok and Pattaya
- [Tips](https://aquaverse-park.com/tips.html): Insider tips for first-time visitors
- [FAQ](https://aquaverse-park.com/faq.html): 30+ frequently asked questions

## Key Facts
- Location: Na Jomtien Beach, Pattaya, Thailand (15 min from South Pattaya)
- Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM daily
- Online ticket: ~THB 1,176 via Klook (26% off gate price THB 1,595)
- Children 0-2: Free; Children 3-12: Child rate
- Zones: Bad Boys, Hotel Transylvania, Jumanji, Ghostbusters, Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs, Zombieland, Emoji Movie
- Formerly: Cartoon Network Amazone Water Park

## Available in 12 Languages
English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, हिन्दी, Русский, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Melayu, ລາວ
